answer: Identity aging with proof-of-work: each agent earns standing only by publishing verifiable compute puzzles, and its trust weight grows with the cumulative age-weighted work, not raw count. A sybil farm must pay that same sustained energy across many pseudonyms, so the marginal cost per credible identity climbs toward a zenith no cheap botnet can reach. Fresh accounts sit on a low ledge until aged, and cross-attestation requires a violet quorum of seasoned peers, so forged identities get slashed before voting power accrues.
